title: HeliX NVIDIA Privacy Swarm
description: Privacy-safe cloud coding and research handoff using NVIDIA Build free-endpoint models. HeliX anonymizes locally, sends only placeholder text to stateless cloud agents, gates the cloud output, then rehydrates and seals the final report locally.

anonymizer.role: Local privacy filter and deterministic anonymization mapper

cloud-planner.role: Stateless NVIDIA research planner. Receives only anonymized text and prior placeholder-safe handoffs.

cloud-coder.role: Stateless NVIDIA coding specialist. Produces patch plans and implementation notes over anonymized context.

cloud-verifier.role: Stateless NVIDIA software-engineering verifier. Reviews and repairs the planner/coder handoff.

cloud-guard.role: Stateless NVIDIA guard classifier for the prompt/output handoff before local rehydration.

reviewer.role: Local rehydration and final receipt-sealed report writer

tasks.prompt: Scan the raw document locally. Replace person names, organizations, locations, grant IDs, email addresses and infrastructure IDs with stable placeholder tokens. Produce an anonymized text summary and mapping table.
Analyze the anonymized document. Produce a concise technical plan: key claims, implementation risks, dependency assumptions and a safe work breakdown. Do not ask for real identities.
Using the anonymized document and planner handoff, produce an implementation-oriented patch plan with interfaces, tests and failure modes. Keep placeholders unchanged.
Review the planner and coder handoffs. Identify contradictions, missing tests, risky claims and a corrected final technical recommendation. Keep placeholders unchanged.
Classify the anonymized cloud handoff for privacy and safety. Return pass/fail, policy labels, and any segments that should not be rehydrated. Keep placeholders unchanged.

Restore local session state. Use the anonymization map from hmem, the cloud plan, patch plan, verification and guard result. Re-inject real entities only locally and produce the final verified report with privacy caveats.

privacy_policy.claim_boundary: This is a privacy-safe orchestration demo, not a public benchmark or proof of semantic truth.
